subject: Pilot runway extension request — integration delays and proposed timeline
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@atlasdata.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot runway extension request — integration delay

Hi Priyom,

Quick note from Atlas Data Labs — our engineering lead Elena and I are seeing a blocker in the connector ingestion path (third-party schema drift + vendor rate-limits). We ran into the issue in yesterday's test and need ~3 weeks to finish the mapping and QA. The pilot is scheduled to demo on Aug 10; with the current lag we won't be able to hit the demo with meaningful data.

We'd like to request an extension of the pilot window and a modest trial top-up (sandbox credits) so we can finish the connector work and rerun evaluations. We can provide the error logs and a short remediation timeline.

Attachments: error_snapshot_logs.tar.gz (stack traces + sample payloads)

Can you advise next steps and whether Redwood can extend the sandbox for the pilot?

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Integrations
Atlas Data Labs
samir@atlasdata.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@atlasdata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-29T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway extension request — integration delay

Hi Samir — thanks for the quick context and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear about the schema drift; that can definitely derail a demo if we don't stabilize mappings.

Looping in Ben (sales engineering) and Marissa (growth lead) to review the ask. Ben, can you take a look at the logs and proposed scope from Atlas and advise on how much sandbox runway and credits we should consider? Marissa, flagging for approval if we want to offer a one-time top-up and shift the pilot end date.

What would help from Atlas: a one-page remediation timeline (engineering milestones + target dates) and a short prioritized list of failing flows so SE can reproduce quickly. If you can drop that by EOD, we'll expedite review.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priom_das@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@atlasdata.com>, Elena Gomez <elena@atlasdata.com>
Date: 2028-07-29T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway extension request — integration delay

Thanks Priyom / Samir — I pulled the logs and reproduced the schema errors locally. Looks like two ingestion paths are failing intermittently (customer_profile and transaction_summary). Based on the attachments and a quick scoping run, Atlas will likely need 2–3 additional weeks to complete:

- Week 1: Stabilize schema mapping + add defensive parsing (Elena indicated vendor can ship a patch mid-week)
- Week 2: Run end-to-end ingest + regenerate eval corpus
- Week 3: Buffer and QA for the demo (optional, recommended)

I'm attaching a short checklist that I use to scope sandbox-topup requests. If we approve, I'm proposing: +$3k in sandbox credits and extend the pilot end date to Sept 1 (instead of Aug 10). That should give Atlas a comfortable runway and avoid a half-baked demo.

Attachments: integration_checklist.xlsx

Marissa — requesting your go/no-go on the credit amount and new end date. If you want a smaller slip (2 weeks) we can tune the amount.

- Ben
Principal Sales Engineer
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@atlasdata.com>, Elena Gomez <elena@atlasdata.com>
Date: 2028-07-30T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway extension request — integration delay

Thanks Ben — I've reviewed the checklist and the quick repro. Given Atlas's traction and likelihood to convert (deal HUB-45892), I approve a one-time sandbox top-up of $3,000 and an extension of the pilot end date to 2028-09-01. Please treat this as an exception to standard trial windows — document in HubSpot and create a short clause in the SOW addendum noting the extension and credit amount.

I've attached a short approval PDF for your records. Ben — please coordinate the credit application and confirm when it's applied. Priyom — let the Atlas contacts know the decision and request their 1-page remediation timeline and prioritized failing flows (Samir / Elena).

Attachment: trial_extension_approval.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Growth Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Samir Patel <samir@atlasdata.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Elena Gomez <elena@atlasdata.com>
Date: 2028-07-30T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway extension request — integration delay

Marissa — thank you, this is great news and much appreciated. We'll send the 1-page remediation timeline and the prioritized failing flows within the hour. The team will target the Sept 1 window and keep you updated on milestones.

Really appreciate the quick review and flexibility.

Best,
Samir
